entities.name: Bernie Tormé
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Bernie Tormé was an Irish rock guitarist, songwriter, record label and recording studio owner. Tormé is best known for his work with Gillan, as well as his brief stint with Ozzy Osbourne replacing Randy Rhoads. After two solo albums, he formed the band Tormé. He also became the lead guitarist of the band Desperado with Twisted Sister singer Dee Snider. From 2014 to 2018, Tormé released four solo albums.
